data.title: Essenl1fe
data.about:
ESSENL1FE by Object 1 at Jumeirah Village Triangle (JVT) introduces a new standard of luxurious living in Dubai. Designed for elegance and convenience, this remarkable development offers a selection of studio, 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments. Essenl1fe amenities include a stunning swimming pool, gym, kid's play zones, and unique features like an outdoor crossfit area and cinema. Each space reflects sophistication and functionality, ensuring a lifestyle of comfort and leisure.

The Essenl1fe Master Plan places residents in the heart of JVT, with seamless connectivity to major attractions, business hubs, and green spaces. The Essenl1fe Floor Plan showcases intelligently designed layouts, maximizing space and style for every need. Flexible Essenl1fe Payment Plan options make owning a home here accessible and stress-free, catering to modern buyers and investors.

characteristics_module.title: ESSENL1FE Residence: Inspired by the True Essence of Life
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Exceptional Location: Positioned in the prestigious District 3 of Jumeirah Village Triangle, offering unparalleled access to Dubai's vibrant cityscape while ensuring a serene and peaceful residential environment.
  • Iconic Design: A modern architectural masterpiece featuring a blend of residential, retail, and office spaces with a thoughtfully planned layout and state-of-the-art infrastructure.
  • Comprehensive Amenities: A diverse range of world-class facilities, including a swimming pool, gym, yoga areas, outdoor lounges, a kid’s play area, and a clubhouse, creating a complete lifestyle solution.
  • Tailored Living Spaces: Wide selection of units, from stylish studios to expansive three-bedroom apartments, designed to cater to various lifestyles and preferences.
  • Proximity to Key Destinations: It is close to Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Golf Estates, and other key hubs, ensuring convenience for work, leisure, and everyday needs.
  • Integrated Community Living: Combines the best of urban living and green spaces, fostering a balanced and harmonious lifestyle.
  • Future-Ready Development: Scheduled for completion in Q4 2027, with high appreciation potential in Dubai’s rapidly growing real estate market.
  • Well-Connected Infrastructure: Seamless connectivity to major roads and public transport, ensuring easy access to all parts of Dubai.

location_tile.title: A Prime Locale in the Heart of Jumeirah Village Triangle
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
ESSENL1FE is strategically nestled in the prestigious District 3 of Jumeirah Village Triangle, offering residents luxury and convenience. This vibrant community boasts seamless connectivity to Dubai's vital urban hubs, creating a tranquil and dynamic life. Residents will enjoy proximity to top-tier amenities and lush green spaces, encapsulating the perfect blend of city excitement and serene retreat.

With its strategic placement, ESSENL1FE provides unparalleled access to Dubai's leading attractions. The thriving environment ensures that every lifestyle need is easily met, from upscale dining and entertainment options to world-class educational institutions. This location promises an exceptional quality of life for discerning residents seeking both sophistication and convenience.

  • 10 Minutes to Mall of the Emirates
  • 15 Minutes to Dubai Marina
  • 20 Minutes to Downtown Dubai
  • 25 Minutes to Dubai International Airport
  • 30 Minutes to Palm Jumeirah
